snippet.title: Cafe Owner Simulator Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Cafe Owner Simulator Steam Play Test starts 19.02.2022.
Also Cafe Owner Simulator will participate in Steam Next Fest February 2022

We're hope you'll enjoy the game at current development stage.

Open your dream restaurant at FPP. Create a unique exterior and interior, hire the best workers and chefs, create a place where people will love to eat, spend time and spend their money. Simulation of the restaurant business.

Check Out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1498140/Cafe_Owner_Simulator/
Discord: https://discord.gg/tXWpAx5Vwp
Twitter: https://twitter.com/cafe_simulator
